headline: Japan Considers Lifting Ban on US Potato Imports Under Trade Pressure
summary: Japan's government is considering lifting an import ban on fresh American potatoes following pressure from Donald Trump, a move domestic farmers argue threatens their livelihoods.
why: Bilateral agricultural trade negotiations between the United States and Japan impact farm exports, bilateral trade relations, and domestic food supply chains.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Lifting import bans would open the domestic Japanese market to foreign agricultural competition.

impacts.name: United States
